reason: A DSH companion plugin that provides an animated desktop or web floating pet with audio interactions and task-state notifications, plus an optional account-balance widget and installation patches.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供带动画、语音互动和任务状态提醒的桌面或网页悬浮桌宠，并可显示账户余额徽章。
summaries.en: Adds an animated desktop or web floating pet for DSH with voice interactions, task-status notifications, and an optional account-balance badge.

capabilities: Creates a transparent always-on-top desktop pet window
Injects a floating web overlay into the DSH web interface
Listens to DSH session events to display work, completion, error, approval, and progress states
Plays bundled offline voice and sound effects
Proxies a balance endpoint and displays account balance information
Provides PowerShell installation, uninstallation, and optional application patching scripts
